verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is Perplexity Computer. MCP clients can delegate complex multi-step work to it, and it acts on its own: it launches browser sessions automatically, runs code in a sandbox, and uses 400+ connectors. That is autonomous agentic execution, but nothing documents user-configured automations that run on a schedule or trigger in the background, and a hands-on report says Computer sessions often fail to trigger or stall. missing for 10: scheduled/recurring or trigger-based automation setup, documented background execution without user presence, monitoring/notification of automation runs, independent corroboration of reliable autonomous runs.
